skill.summary: Generate professional, empathetic customer service responses in seconds. Handle complaints, questions, refunds, and reviews with consistent quality.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Customer Response Generator.
- Generate fast, professional, and empathetic replies for common customer inquiries.
- Supports tailored response templates for complaints, questions, refunds, and reviews.
- De-escalation strategies are built in for handling upset customers.
- Ready for use across multiple channels including email, chat, and social platforms.
- Ensures consistent tone aligned with your brand voice.
